The CI workflow ensures that no auto-publish or automated betting occurs, which is achieved through guardrail scripts that block any attempt to write to published fields or trigger external communications. This is mathematically modeled as a constrained optimization problem where the objective function is minimized over internal-only variables. The model freeze state acts as a constant parameter in the system's dynamics, ensuring stability during calibration. The content draft-only mechanism enforces a state transition from draft to review, which is a deterministic process governed by a finite automaton. The failure mode arises when sandbox limitations prevent local builds, indicating a breakdown in the execution layer rather than the logical one.
